panels.title: 总览 · 整体与三方向趋势
panels.description: 推/拉/蹲三方向每练总容量（Σ重量×次数）+ 3点移动平均；整体线 = 按周取三方向容量均值（缺方向时用现存方向平均）。

targets.query: from(bucket: "training") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^ppl_(push|pull|squat)_/) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "weight_kg" or r._field == "reps") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session_id", "set_index"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.direction == "push") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r.weight_kg) * float(v: r.reps)})) |> group(columns: []) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "推日容量") |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> movingAverage(n: 3)

from(bucket: "training") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^ppl_(push|pull|squat)_/) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "weight_kg" or r._field == "reps") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session_id", "set_index"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.direction == "pull") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r.weight_kg) * float(v: r.reps)})) |> group(columns: []) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "拉日容量") |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> movingAverage(n: 3)

from(bucket: "training") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^ppl_(push|pull|squat)_/) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "weight_kg" or r._field == "reps") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session_id", "set_index"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r.weight_kg) * float(v: r.reps)})) |> group(columns: ["direction"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1w, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> truncateTimeColumn(unit: 1w) |> group(columns: ["_time"]) |> mean() |> group(columns: []) |> set(key: "_field", value: "整体(周均值)")

panels.title: PR · 蹲日 动作最大次数

panels.description: 每天一次静息心率（bpm）。原始点 + 7 点移动平均（虚线）。预警：单日 ≥ 基线+5 或 +10% → 当天不加负荷不冲 PR；减载：连续 3 天高于基线 → 四查恢复项。基线 = 最近 7 天中位数，口径见处方文档 §8.1。

targets.query: from(bucket: "training") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ppl_morning_hr") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bpm") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "晨脉")

from(bucket: "training") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ppl_morning_hr") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bpm") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> movingAverage(n: 7) |> set(key: "_field", value: "晨脉 7日均线MA")
